Riley: Quick request 1for webinar follow-up: one-page decision aid comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Audience = platform security + procurement. Needs: short deployment guidance, tiny 3-row micro-compare, two safe benchmark callouts (no raw latency numbers), and a gated routing CTA so SDRs can classify inbound. Keep it scannable.
Sam: I can draft copy. Suggest headline: "Inference choices for secure production". Layout: 3 stacked cards, a 3-row micro-compare (Security | SLA | Typical buyer), and a 3-question SDR triage block. Use phrasing like "low p95 latency profiles" and "meaningful unit-cost improvements with batching and quantization; workload dependent." Link to benchmark hub ID BH-2024-21.
Nora: Add legal-safe footnote: "Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns." Also remove any vendor KMS names. Avoid saying "air-gapped turnkey" unless Ops validates.
LegalBot: Confirmed. Benchmark references must cite BH-2024-21 and include Ops sign-off. No direct cryptography vendor claims.
Ops: Acknowledge. I'll review BH-2024-21 link before publish; add @ops to reviewers.
Sam: Draft copy below (for review):

"Inference choices for secure production"

Hosted  Fastest time-to-value  Quick onboarding and hosted API; ideal for feature validation. Security: shared infra, tenant isolation, RBAC.

Dedicated  Predictable capacity & SLAs  Reserved GPU pools and configurable autoscale. Security: data-isolated pools and stronger access controls.

Private  Compliance-first control  VPC/on-prem options with audit logging and customer KMS integrations. Security: network isolation and enterprise controls.

Micro-compare (Security | SLA | Typical buyer): Hosted: Shared controls | Best-effort latency | Prototyping; Dedicated: Isolated pools | SLA-backed | Production scale; Private: Full control | Configurable SLAs | Regulated orgs.

Benchmarks: See BH-2024-21 for latency profiles by model/region and cost comparison notes. Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.

SDR triage (quick): Data residency required? | SLA required? | Peak throughput band: <2k | 2k-20k | >20k

Routing CTA: Book a deployment review (shortlink: redwood.ai/route)  gated intake captures buyer signals and routes to the correct sales lane.

Nora: Minor edits look good. Sam: replace the shortlink in the PDF with the gated link and tag @ops for final sign-off. Owner: Sam. Reviewers: @Nora, @LegalBot, @Ops. Timeline: PDF draft tomorrow AM, final by EOD Friday.
